source: AntiChat Mac fixtures: tools/forty-tools.json and prompts/tool-select-200.jsonl (CC0, generated text, no personal data)

tools.name: get_time
tools.description: Get the current date and time, in the user's time zone or in a given IANA time zone.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the web for current information. Use when the answer needs facts newer than your training or the user asks to search.

tools.name: read_url
tools.description: Read the page at a URL the user gave and answer from it.

tools.name: create_image
tools.description: Create a picture from a text description. Use it whenever the user asks for an image, drawing, photo or illustration.

tools.name: edit_image
tools.description: Change an existing picture as described (edit it, or fill a masked area).

tools.name: create_document
tools.description: Create a downloadable document file (PDF, Word .docx or Markdown .md) from Markdown. Use it when the user asks for a file, report, letter, handout or export (slide decks: create_presentation; spreadsheets: create_spreadsheet). Write the full content in `markdown` (headings, lists, tables, code, images as ![alt](ref) where ref is an id from `images`). To change a file you made earlier, pass its artifact_id as `revises`. Runs on this Mac; nothing is uploaded.

tools.name: create_spreadsheet
tools.description: Create a downloadable spreadsheet (Excel .xlsx or .csv). Give each sheet typed columns and either `rows` (values) or `data_ref` (the data_ref of a query_data result — required when the data came from an attached file). Optional: Excel formulas by cell ({"B14": "SUM(B2:B13)"}, no "="), number formats, a native chart. To change a file you made earlier, pass its artifact_id as `revises`. Runs on this Mac; nothing is uploaded.

tools.name: export_table
tools.description: Save a query_data result (its data_ref) as a downloadable .csv or .xlsx file. Use it when the user wants the table itself as a file.

tools.name: create_presentation
tools.description: Create a downloadable slide deck (PowerPoint .pptx; opens in Keynote and PowerPoint). 1–30 slides; layouts: title, bullets, image, title_bullets_image; up to 8 short bullets per slide; optional speaker notes; images by attachment or file id. Themes: clean (default), dusk, paper, bold. To change a deck you made earlier, pass its artifact_id as `revises`. Runs on this Mac; nothing is uploaded.

tools.name: create_chart
tools.description: Draw a chart inline in the chat from a Vega-Lite v6 spec (bar, line, area, point, arc/pie, heatmap…). When the data comes from an attached sheet or a query_data result, pass that result's `data_ref` and leave `data.values` out of the spec — the app injects the exact rows; encode the result's column names as fields and do not re-aggregate a grouped result. Only for numbers the user typed in the conversation may the spec carry inline `data.values`. To change a chart you made earlier, pass its artifact_id as `revises`. Runs on this Mac; nothing is uploaded.

tools.name: query_data
tools.description: Run one read-only SQL query (DuckDB dialect) over the spreadsheets attached to this chat. Each sheet is a table; the table names, columns and types are in the <sheet_tables> block. Use SELECT / WITH / SUMMARIZE / DESCRIBE / PIVOT only; quote names with double quotes. Per month: select strftime("date", '%Y-%m') AS month and GROUP BY that same expression (grouping by the raw date gives one row per day). Returns up to 200 rows plus a data_ref for charts and exports.

tools.name: memory
tools.description: Save, update, delete or view facts about the user. Save only when the user asks you to remember something, or when you propose it and the user agrees. Tag facts about health, sexuality, religion, politics or money with sensitive_category.

tools.name: create_video
tools.description: Create a short video clip from a text description, or animate a picture.

tools.name: team_chat_search_messages
tools.description: Search the team's messages by words.

tools.name: team_chat_send_message
tools.description: Send a message to a channel.

tools.name: github_search_repositories
tools.description: Search GitHub repositories by name, topic or language.

tools.name: github_create_issue
tools.description: Open a new issue in a GitHub repository.

tools.name: github_list_pull_requests
tools.description: List the open pull requests of a GitHub repository.

tools.name: github_get_file_contents
tools.description: Read a file from a GitHub repository at a branch or commit.

tools.name: github_create_pull_request
tools.description: Open a pull request from one branch into another.

tools.name: notion_search
tools.description: Search pages and databases in the user's Notion workspace.

tools.name: notion_create_page
tools.description: Create a new Notion page with a title and content.

tools.name: notion_append_block
tools.description: Add text to the end of an existing Notion page.

tools.name: linear_list_issues
tools.description: List Linear issues, filtered by team, assignee or state.

tools.name: linear_create_issue
tools.description: Create a Linear issue in a team with a title and description.

tools.name: linear_update_issue
tools.description: Change a Linear issue's state, assignee or priority.

tools.name: calendar_list_events
tools.description: List the events on the user's calendar between two dates.

tools.name: calendar_create_event
tools.description: Add an event to the user's calendar.

tools.name: calendar_find_free_time
tools.description: Find free time slots in the user's calendar for a meeting of a given length.

tools.name: drive_search_files
tools.description: Search the user's cloud drive for files by name or content.

tools.name: drive_read_file
tools.description: Read the text of a file in the user's cloud drive.

tools.name: weather_get_forecast
tools.description: Get the weather forecast for a place for the next days.

tools.name: stripe_list_payments
tools.description: List recent payments received in the Stripe account.

tools.name: stripe_create_invoice
tools.description: Create and send a Stripe invoice to a customer.

tools.name: maps_search_places
tools.description: Find places such as restaurants, shops or museums near a location.

tools.name: maps_get_directions
tools.description: Get travel directions and time between two places.

tools.name: composio_composio_search_tools
tools.description: Find the tools that fit a use case across the toolkits enabled for this session.

tools.name: composio_composio_get_tool_schemas
tools.description: Return the full input schemas of tools found by COMPOSIO_SEARCH_TOOLS.

tools.name: composio_composio_manage_connections
tools.description: Check or start the connection of a toolkit for this user.

tools.name: composio_composio_multi_execute_tool
tools.description: Execute one or more tools found by COMPOSIO_SEARCH_TOOLS, in parallel.
